description: Mancala (Kalah rules) — sow stones, earn extra turns, capture opponents, and beat the computer.

faqs.a: If your last stone lands in your store (the big pit on your right), you get another turn immediately.
faqs.q: How do I get an extra turn?

faqs.a: If your last stone lands in an empty pit on your side, you capture that stone plus everything in the opposite pit into your store.
When one side's six pits are all empty, the game ends — every remaining stone goes to its owner's store, and the bigger store wins.

howto: You own the bottom row — click one of your pits to sow its stones.
Stones drop one per pit, counterclockwise, skipping the opponent's store.
Land your last stone in your store for a free turn.
Land it in an empty pit on your side to capture the opposite pit.
title: Mancala
